what: The Run v5d: camera keys for the one continuous shot (Fable, 2026-10-26). Keys sit on marble-timeline.json frames; the marble, the bake, the lamp and the ending are unchanged from v5c.

lens.note: one prime for the whole shot; record_pose is calibrated at 50 mm

frame_of_reference: table frame (channel_v5c): metres, origin at the top's near-left corner, x along the 3.0 m length, y away from the near edge, z up from the oak top

unchanged: every sheet, the galley, the coins, the weights, the globe
the stick chart stays on the wall at x 1.10-1.90
the release block, channel, leather, steps, felt, well and record (physics and A7)
layout.admiralty_weight: none: its roll holds it; give the open corner nearest reach 3 a 1.5 mm lift (flat_sheet lift) so it reads as a sheet unrolled and left
layout.ino_admiralty_on_reach_2: solved by the camera: far-side camera with the marble in the lower frame; the band-B sheet edge that enters the bottom 5% of frame is the blank margin at 0.3 m, 20-30 px soft

conventions.rel: eye = marble + D * (cos(el) cos(h+az), cos(el) sin(h+az), sin(el)); h = the marble's heading from the bake (atan2 of the position 3 frames ahead minus 3 frames behind); az negative = to the marble's right
conventions.abs: eye given in the table frame
conventions.marble_screen: [sx, sy]: where the marble sits in the frame, as fractions of width and height from the centre, + right / + up. The aim (look_at) is solved per frame so the marble lands there: look_at = eye + f * |marble - eye| where f is the forward direction that projects the marble at (sx, sy); up = +z until the ending
conventions.interpolation: eye: smootherstep between consecutive keys. sx, sy, f-stop, focus distance: smootherstep between keys. The aim is recomputed EVERY frame from the marble's actual position (never interpolate look_at between keys). Opening: eye blends from key 0 to key 90 with smootherstep(f/90); the aim blends from key 0's look_at to the marble-placed aim with smootherstep(f/48). Ending: from frame 927 the whole pose blends toward record_pose(rec) exactly as shot_v5c does (b = smootherstep((t - (t_rest - 0.5)) / ((t_end - 1.0) - (t_rest - 0.5)))), up from +z to +y, f-stop to 5.6, focus to the sheet; pose at 1061, held to 1090.
conventions.focus: 'marble' = eye-to-marble distance; '<point>' = eye-to-point distance (a rack); 'split:<point>' = harmonic mean of the two distances (the stop then carries both)
conventions.rack_limit: the marble may be soft only while its blur diameter <= 0.5 of its own image diameter (measured here: <= 0.33), its image >= 90 px, on a straight, at <= 0.30 m/s, never through a step or a bank; a rack lasts <= 0.5 s out, <= 0.5 s hold, <= 0.4 s back

reads: the whole run and every artifact, the lamp's pool; the latch releases
beats.move: the opening wide from 1.6 m, descending obliquely to the lead
beats.why: the table is seen once, whole, as a plan of time; the descent lands ahead of the marble so the first thing read is where it started

beats.move: lead: the camera ahead on the near side, retreating at the marble's speed, looking back
beats.why: the tablet stands behind the marble, the papyrus runs toward the camera; f/11 carries both (marble blur 6.7 px, tablet 5-8 px)
the two coins bracket the sheet; the sestertius passes between camera and marble

reads: Catalan Atlas (1375) entering behind the marble
beats.move: the park: the camera stops on the near side by the Atlas; the marble approaches, the frame turns with it
beats.why: a parked camera lets the marble do the moving; as it comes abeam the Atlas board lies directly behind it. Band A's leaf and galley sweep through the far frame at 1 m, 15-25 px soft

beats.move: rack focus on leather L3 (170-188): marble sharp to 184, onto the Atlas by 190, held to 198, back by 206
beats.why: the maker slowed the marble here; the camera's attention lifts to the record beside it. Marble blur at the rack 33 px of 102 px (0.33)

beats.move: crane-up to the +x corner (3.06, -0.14, 0.55), then parked: the turn-1 breath
beats.why: from high on the +x corner the marble rounds the bank at the frame's right while the Atlas fills the left; the frame top cuts the table at about 1.3 m so band B and the well stay out (well 2% for 17 frames). The dark room is not in frame, so the meter stays calm

reads: jeton on the Atlas corner, beside the groove (352-385)
beats.move: traverse along the table's end to the far side of reach 2, descending behind the marble
beats.focus: marble, then the jeton (0.70 m; the marble at 0.63 m is sharp too)
beats.why: the 15th-century counter is read where it now lies, between the Atlas and the leaf. The marble stays at the frame's right so the frame extends over the Atlas, not over band B; the Admiralty's near margin shows at the right edge for about 20 frames, foreshortened and 20 px soft

beats.move: far-side follow (over band B), looking steeply down into band A; the marble in the lower frame
beats.why: L0: the camera's side keeps the Ino and the Admiralty below the frame; only their blank near margin enters the bottom 5%, at 0.3 m, 20-30 px soft

beats.move: rack focus on leather L4 (428-456): marble to 433, onto the leaf by 441, held to 452, back by 460
beats.why: the smallest type at the slowest marble (0.22 m/s). Marble blur 39 px of 119 px (0.33)

reads: Piri Reis open edge entering right
beats.move: the crossing: the camera passes behind the marble over step 1 (475), from the far side to the near side
beats.why: both 1455 and 1513 share the frame for a second in the order the groove gives them; the step's tok lands with the marble sharp

reads: nested weights standing on its roll
beats.move: near-side low follow; rack focus on leather L5 (493-516): onto Piri by 514, held to 522, back by 528
beats.why: the open edge faces reach 2; from the near side the sheet lies beyond the marble with the weights as its vertical. Marble blur 21 px of 119 px (0.17)

reads: Doppelmayr globe (1728), whole from 584 to 642 (its top cap clipped by the frame edge for 0.3 s at the breath's entry and exit)
beats.move: crane-up (528-575) to a high eye inside the bank, (1.42-1.46, 1.02-1.18, 0.98-1.02), then parked: the turn-2 breath, panning with the marble
beats.why: the marble clears the groove's lip only from 40 deg or more here (visible share 0.62-1.0 by the ray-cast); from 1.0 m up inside the bank the whole globe still fits the 50 mm frame with the marble at the bottom (28-30 px). The lower two-thirds of the frame is lit oak and the globe stands against the table's end, so the meter sees oak, not the dark wall

reads: Piri's roll as the paper under the weights
beats.move: the camera descends across the groove 0.6 m ahead of the marble to the wall side, then leads it nearly along the groove (az 20-25 deg, 24 deg elevation) looking back; rack focus on leather L6 (729-763): onto the weights by 745, held to 757, back by 767
beats.why: along the groove the lip cannot hide the marble (share 0.9-1.0). The weights stand behind the marble at the frame's left with the globe beyond. Marble blur at the rack 34 px of 107 (0.32)

reads: Ino's sheet (1821), its survey, from above
beats.move: the crane-over: the camera lifts to 50 deg over the marble as it passes beneath (abeam at 790) and settles high behind-left (46 deg, az +135); rack focus on leather L7 (799-839): onto the Ino by 816, held to 830, back by 841
beats.focus: split marble/Ino, then marble -> ino_near (0.59 m) -> marble
beats.why: abeam the marble is visible only from about 50 deg, so the pass is taken over the top; a flat sheet reads best from above anyway. Marble share 0.81-0.92; blur at the rack 21 px of 97 (0.22)

beats.move: high 3/4 follow from behind-left (44 deg, az +140); the marble sharp through the slowest point (860) and step 2 (863)
beats.why: the step's tok and the re-acceleration are the marble's own beat; nothing racks here. Marble share 0.75-0.83

reads: Admiralty chart 983, its soundings, from above
the well's mouth at the frame's left from 897
beats.move: high 3/4 from the wall side (50-52 deg, az +126-128), deep stop; the marble at the frame's left so the frame extends over the chart and away from the record
beats.why: the last record before the film's own reads at depth, not by a rack, so the eye stays with the marble as it slows on L8 toward the lip. The record enters only at 931-933. Marble share 0.6-0.77

reads: the film's record on the felt
beats.move: the ending as v5c: the pose blends from the frame-926 camera (0.46 m, 46 deg, wall side) to record_pose(rec) by 1061 (up from +z to +y), held to 1090; hard cut to the lockup
beats.why: unchanged so POSE_EV, the albedo and A7 carry over. The approach comes from the wall side and above; the per-film tail starts at 897 (the well) and the record first enters at 931

keys.beat: B0 opening wide (whole run), descending to B1 over 3.0 s
B3 the Atlas enters behind the marble
B4 L3: the marble slows abeam
B4 back to the marble, leaving
B5 traverse along the table's end
B5 traverse; the Atlas left, the marble right
B6 the jeton on the Atlas corner, beside the groove
B7 L4 rack to the leaf

keys.builder_note: Fable's section 10 fallback (turn-2 meter swing over 0.7 stop): the entry eye held 0.1 m lower until 585
Fable's section 10 fallback (turn-2 meter swing over 0.7 stop): the entry eye held 0.1 m lower until 585

keys.beat: B10 the breath's entry held low (Fable's section 10 fallback)
keys.builder_note: Fable's section 10 fallback (turn-2 meter swing over 0.7 stop): the entry eye held 0.1 m lower until 585; this key is the re-keyed path at 585, 0.1 m lower

keys.beat: B11 descending across the groove ahead of the marble
B11 lead: the weights beside the marble, the globe behind
B11 L6 rack to the weights
B12 over the marble; the Ino revealed below
B12 L7 rack to the Ino
B15 lip; the ending's blend starts at 927

checks.marble_in_frame: frames 0-975 (leaves the frame during the ending's move onto the record, as in v5c)
checks.render_cost_estimate: prefix 1091 x 8.1 s = 2.45 h; per-film extra 2 x 247 x ~9 s = 1.24 h; wides (turn breaths, ~250 frames) +~3 s each = +0.2 h; meter 70 s; total about 3.9 h at 512 spp
